exposed_dft_features.name: Device Self-Test (Admin OPC=14h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Initiates a Short or Extended self-test of the controller and namespaces; results in Device Self-Test log (LID=06h).

exposed_dft_features.name: Get Log Page
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Standard observability for SMART/Health, Error Information, Firmware Slot, Telemetry, Persistent Event, Endurance Group, Sanitize Status, ANA, Commands Supported & Effects.

exposed_dft_features.name: Asynchronous Event Request (OPC=0Ch)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Async notification channel for SMART thresholds, error events, namespace attribute notices, firmware activation events, predictable latency event aggregate notices, ANA changes.

exposed_dft_features.name: Telemetry Host-Initiated Log (LID=07h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Vendor-specific telemetry binary blob retrieved on host demand for failure analysis.

exposed_dft_features.name: Telemetry Controller-Initiated Log (LID=08h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Vendor-specific telemetry blob initiated by controller (e.g. on error).

exposed_dft_features.name: Persistent Event Log (LID=0Dh, NVMe 1.4)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Power-loss-survivable ring of significant events for boot-time triage.

exposed_dft_features.name: Shadow Doorbell Buffer (Doorbell Buffer Config, OPC=7Ch)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Reduces MMIO traffic in emulated environments; useful as a debug observation surface.

exposed_dft_features.name: PCIe Advanced Error Reporting (AER) Capability
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Link-layer error observability via PCI Configuration Space — Correctable / Non-Fatal / Fatal error masks and headers.

fields.no_jtag_on_form_factor_connector: NVMe Base 1.4 does NOT define JTAG / scan / boundary-scan signals on M.2 / U.2 / EDSFF connectors. Some form factors (notably EDSFF E3) provide a maintenance / serial port for vendor debug, but it is not NVMe-spec-defined. Vendor silicon debug is via wafer-probe or package-level JTAG, hidden from the host.
fields.notes: NVMe Base 1.4 has no formal scan / DFT architecture exposed at the bus interface. The Device Self-Test command + Get Log Page logs + AER are the only protocol-level observability mechanisms. Internal NAND test, bad-block management, ECC scrub, and read-margining are vendor-specific and not visible to the host.
